title: Oregon MathCounts
text:
The 2020 Oregon MATHCOUNTS team consisted of Justin Xia, Ryan Liu, Derek Aslan, and Ethan Zhang. They were not able to compete at the National Finals as they were cancelled due to COVID.

The 2019 Oregon MATCHCOUNTS team consisted of Ram Goel, Suyash Pandit, Alan Kappler, and Nividh Singh. As a team, they placed 7th, believed to be Oregon's 2nd best performance in the history of MATHCOUNTS. Also this year, Oregon is believed to have become the smallest state (in terms of population rank) to place three team members in the countdown round.
